feeds.title: OnePeterFive » Marriage
feeds.description: In our blog, you will find articles that describe contemporary marriage rites, how we have to adapt to change, and more. OnePeterFive exists as a place to begin rebuilding the Catholic ethos. We're not just here to zero in on the problems, but to offer concrete solutions. We want to restore Catholic culture, rebuild the Church as a patron of the arts, reinvigorate the family and the traditions that keep it strong, reform the liturgy, support vocations, dust off the old devotions and make them relevant again.

feeds.title: Catholic-Link » Marriage
feeds.description: Read articles about Catholic marriage. Catholic-Link.org seeks to evangelize through education and beauty by providing a vast online library of Catholic articles, images, quotes, and videos.

feeds.title: The Catholic Weekly » Family & Marriage
feeds.description: Read our blog to know about family and marriage issues, how to solve them, and more. The Catholic Weekly is proudly Catholic, proudly counter-cultural, and proudly in favor of life. We strive to share our vision of the Church, the Lord, and the life-changing possibilities of the Christian path with our readers, providing a degree of Catholic clarity for complex times.

feeds.title: Catholic Mom » Marriage
feeds.description: Explore articles to know more about marriage in Christianity. At Catholic Mom, our mission is to support and encourage every woman in the vocation of Catholic motherhood. With more than 130 contributors from all walks of life, here you will find voices of women from all backgrounds and all ages and stages of life.

feeds.title: The Marriage Group Blog
feeds.description: We help church groups leverage technology to meet today's couples where they are. We help couples with accessible, engaging relationship-building courses. We accomplish this by creating online and on-demand marriage preparation and enrichment courses that are modern and relatable, as well as providing a high level of care to all of our customers. View our list of helpful articles, relationship tips, news, and, more.

feeds.title: Catholic Digest » Relationships
feeds.description: Read about relationships, tips, struggles, and more. Catholic Digest connects with readers through personal stories of triumphs and struggles, joys and challenges, and also the lighter side of Catholic living. We are a source of support and encouragement for those who love their faith, those who struggle with their faith, and those who long to learn more about the richness of Catholic tradition.

feeds.title: SmartLoving Blog
feeds.description: SmartLoving provides resources to support couples throughout their commitment life-cycle. The SmartLoving series is recognized internationally as one of the most comprehensive ranges of materials for Catholic marriage formation. It honors the unique strengths of men and women called to love and to be loved. Masterfully created with multimedia and digital technologies, the courses and publications optimize engagement with participants for a comprehensive and powerful experience.

feeds.title: Agape Catholic Ministries » Marriage
feeds.description: Explore our blog for marriage-related articles. Agape Catholic Marriage Preparation invites couples to a deeper relationship with each other and with Christ, one couple at a time. Online, on-demand instruction rooted in Saint John Paul II's Theology of the Body, combined with personalized mentoring from a trained married couple, builds a foundation for a strong, healthy, Christ-centered marriage between a man and a woman.

feeds.title: Catholic Life » Marriage Matters
feeds.description: Visit our blog for articles that shed light on marriage matters. Catholic Life is the official magazine of the Catholic Diocese of La Crosse. The magazine focuses on evangelizing Christianity.

feeds.title: Marriage Care Blog
feeds.description: It is our mission to share relationship skills and knowledge, and support couples and individuals in the best and worst of times in their relationships, regardless of their ability to pay. We acknowledge, with others, the value and uniqueness of every human being. Love, respect, forgiveness, and the need to work for peace and justice underpin our work.

feeds.title: Covenant Blog
feeds.description: From engagement to happily ever after, find all of your Catholic wedding decisions in a single planner that you can revisit for years to come. With pages to reflect and remember the goal, the Covenant Wedding planner is designed to help you along the engagement journey, where you can return after your wedding to reflect on the excitement and emotions of engagement even years after you say, 'I do.'

feeds.title: New Song
feeds.description: I am Jeremy Holmes. I live with my wife and eight children in Lander, Wyoming. My paycheck comes from teaching theology for Wyoming Catholic College, and of course, a lot of my writing reflects that, but really my writing falls into three areas. I write about my family and stories. This family life is the 'new song' God has Canticum Novumgiven me, and everything else is bits and snatches of the one melody.

feeds.title: Indian Catholic Matters » Marriage
feeds.description: Browse our blog for content on Marriage. Indian Catholic Matters is a Bengaluru-based online publication that publishes about Christianity, faith, and more.

feeds.title: Spoken Bride Blog
feeds.description: A Catholic wedding lifestyle blog for brides & newlyweds. The Spoken Bride is a romantic alight with anticipation for her wedding day, but she knows the foremost romance in life is a divine one. They showcase wedding inspiration that fixes our eyes on the beauty of the Creator. They offer a resource for finding vendors who not only have a wealth of talent for their craft, but who are on fire for the sacrament of marriage and also to help you plan for the biggest day of your life.

feeds.title: Catholic Husband
feeds.description: Hi! My name is Chet. This is a personal blog focused on sharing my experiences and lessons learned in the married life. I've been writing here since 2013 with Alison, my wife, serving as my editor since the very beginning. Catholic Husband covers range of topics including fatherhood, Catholic life, and careers. All of these posts have been written with the intention of helping you to love, lead, & serve your family.

feeds.title: Indianapolis Catholic Wedding Photographer Blog
feeds.description: View full wedding days, tips for planning a Catholic wedding and more by Indianapolis Catholic Wedding Photographer Colette M. She loves creating meaningful and memorable photographs in a timeless fashion.

feeds.title: Faith and Marriage Blog
feeds.description: The Faith & Marriage Apostolate of the Wildwoods Community is dedicated to promoting the Sacramentality of marriage and providing for married couples opportunities for growth, enrichment, and support. Our goal is to awaken married couples to their responsibility to continually grow in their sacramental relationship with God, with one another, and with the community of God's people. We seek to promote such activities to empower them to fulfill their call to love.

feeds.title: Archdiocese of Hobart » Life Family Marriage
feeds.description: For a happy married check out our articles dedicated to marriage. The Catholic Standard reports on local, national, and international issues of importance to the Catholic Church and community. It also communicates the diversity and richness of the Archdiocese as a living community; and includes stories and news from Tasmanian parishes, Tasmania's Catholic Education sector, CatholicCare Tasmania, Centacare Evolve Housing, St Joseph Affordable Homes, Blueline Laundry and from the broader and significant Catholic business and services sector.
